sentences.en: I wonder if you would kindly introduce us to someone.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你是否能引见我们认识某人。

sentences.en: Could you introduce me to Mr Ono of Randolph, Ltd?
sentences.zh: 你能把 Randolph 公司的 Ono 先生介绍给我吗？

sentences.en: I want to introduce you to my parents next Saturday.
sentences.zh: 下星期六我要把我父母介绍给你认识。
